test_command: cd apps/api_server && npx vitest run src/__tests__/live_artifacts.test.ts --no-file-parallelism

criteria.text: Always-on authenticated routes outside env.agentExecutionEnabled: GET /live-artifacts?type=html&search=...; POST /live-artifacts; GET /live-artifacts/:id; GET /live-artifacts/:id/render; PATCH metadata; collaborator GET/POST/DELETE; PUT bundle; PUT state; DELETE soft-delete. Pre-change route impact found no existing route/consumers. createApp impact is LOW, zero indexed upstream dependents/processes.

Create returns stable UUID/type html/title/owner/workspace/visibility/current independent bundle+state revisions/hashes/timestamps/audit, never paths/storage keys. Initial bundle accepts fixed {html, css, js} and state JSON under size limits. Only html type.

Storage derives immutable content-addressed locations only from server-owned ID/hash under env.liveArtifactStorageDir: <id>/bundles/<hash>/{index.html,styles.css,app.js} and <id>/state/<hash>.json; every bundle write fills a unique temp directory before atomic rename, recognizes only a hash-valid complete destination as idempotent, safely heals a legacy empty destination, and leaves no temp directory; no client paths; no partial pointer publication; decoded state max 512 KiB; existing Express 1 MiB ceiling retained.

Authorization: private owner; shared owner+selected current-workspace collaborators; organization owner+current members of workspace. Owner alone manages visibility/collaborators/capability metadata/delete. List omits unauthorized. Unauthorized IDs return non-disclosing 404. Accessible already-open soft-deleted artifact returns path-free 410 artifact_deleted; otherwise 404. Validate collaborator workspace membership using existing task/shared-transcript patterns.

Independent bundle/state optimistic writes carry expected revision; one atomic UPDATE ... WHERE current_revision=expected; stale write returns 409 plus current public revision; simultaneous same-revision writes produce exactly one winner. Successful writes append audit revision with authenticated actor/hash/time and their new bundle renders. Failed storage/DB/CAS cannot advance pointer or append an audit row.

Render assembles only current fixed bundle files with restrictive headers/CSP foundation: nonced product-injected CSS/JS only, default-src 'none', connect-src 'none', no forms/base/frames/objects; no credentials, paths, redirects, or arbitrary stored script tags/event handlers gaining nonce. This slice serves secure document; WKWebView bridge comes later.
PATCH supports title/visibility/declared capabilities but only allowlisted pco.services.read; owner-only capability changes. No generic executor in AV-02.

Focused tests cover unauthenticated/owner/collaborator/same-org/cross-org/private/shared/organization, recipient validation, owner-only management, list filtering, 404/410, soft delete retention, traversal/path non-disclosure, storage hashes, size/type validation, render CSP/nonces, independent CAS, concurrent one-winner, and no leaked internal paths/logs.
Keep code minimal and reuse existing auth/workspace/AppError/DB dialect patterns. No abstraction for future artifact types/capabilities.
